e.title: KBRA（美国）：保险财务实力评级——按子行业、评级动作与地区筛选的发行人库
e.title_en: KBRA (US): insurance financial strength ratings via an issuer database filterable by subsector, rating action and geography
e.title_hk: KBRA（美國）：保險財務實力評級——按子行業、評級動作與地區篩選的發行人庫
e.summary: 美国信用评级机构：保险发行人页以「保险财务实力」为核心，可按子行业（综合/金融担保/寿险健康年金/非寿险产险/再保险）、评级动作（首次授予/跟踪）与地区（欧洲、北美）筛选，并实测列出各发行人及其最近评级动作日期
e.summary_en: A US credit rating agency: its insurance issuers page centres on insurance financial strength, filterable by subsector (composite/multi-line, financial guaranty, life/health/annuity, non-life P&C, reinsurance), by rating action (assigned, surveillance) and by geography (Europe, North America), with measured issuer rows and their latest rating-action dates
e.summary_hk: 美國信用評級機構：保險發行人頁以「保險財務實力」為核心，可按子行業（綜合／金融擔保／壽險健康年金／非壽險產險／再保險）、評級動作（首次授予／跟蹤）與地區（歐洲、北美）篩選，並實測列出各發行人及其最近評級動作日期
e.body:
**KBRA（Kroll Bond Rating Agency，美国信用评级机构）** 的**保险部门页面**——本条目补的是**「保险财务实力评级（Insurance Financial Strength）的公开发行人库」这一形态**：**实测池内 `rating agency` / `insurance financial strength` 均为 0**，**而这是本轮四家机构中唯一在页面上直接把「保险财务实力」写进标题的一家**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Insurance Credit Ratings」页 `/sectors/insurance/issuers` 实测 90.7KB，标题实测为「Insurance Credit Ratings | Insurance Financial Strength」**；**面包屑实测为 Home > Insurance > Insurance Issuers | Publications**。⭐ **该页实测提供三重筛选**：**Subsector（子行业）** 含 **Composite/Multi-Line（综合/多线）**、**Financial Guaranty（金融担保）**、**Life/Health/Annuity（寿险/健康/年金）**、**Non-Life/Property and Casualty（非寿险/财产险）**、**Reinsurance（再保险）**；**Title Rating Action（评级动作）** 含 **Assigned（首次授予）** 与 **Surveillance（跟踪监测）**；**Geography（地区）** 含 **Europe（Belgium / France / Gibraltar / Guernsey / Luxembourg / United Kingdom）** 与 **North America（Bermuda / Cayman Islands / Puerto Rico / United States）**；另有 **Filter by keyword**。⭐ **页面实测列出具体发行人条目及其评级动作与日期**，例如 **「California Earthquake Authority 10 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States」**、**「US Coastal Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States」**、**「US Coastal Property & Casualty Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance …」**。**站点行业列表实测**：**abs / cmbs / corporates / financial-institutions / funds / insurance / project-finance / public-finance / rmbs / sovereigns**，**其中 insurance 下另有 `issuers` 与 `publications` 两个子路径**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐ 补上「保险财务实力评级的公开发行人库」这一形态**——**本轮另外三家（[[lianhe-ratings]]、[[dagong]]、[[r-i]]）以「方法论 + 评级结果/违约数据」为主**，**而 KBRA 公开的是「我评了哪些保险公司」这一可筛选名单**；**对做保险公司信用分析或再保对手方评估的学生，这是一个可直接查找的发行人清单**（**可与 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[sii-spread-risk-scr]] 的资本计量口径并读——那些算「一家公司要留多少资本」，这条给「这家公司的财务实力被打了什么」**）。**② ⭐ 「子行业五分法」本身就是一份保险公司类型清单**——**综合/多线、金融担保、寿险健康年金、非寿险产险、再保险**；**注意其中单列了「金融担保（Financial Guaranty）」与「再保险」**——**这两类是保险业中信用风险结构最特殊的两类**（**金融担保是保单化的信用增强，再保险是保险公司的对手方**），**评级机构把它们与寿险/产险并列，说明其风险口径不同**；**对做险种风险比较的学生，这个分类可直接引用**。**③ ⭐ 「地区筛选」实测覆盖欧洲六地与北美四地（含百慕大、开曼、波多黎各）**——**百慕大、开曼与波多黎各的出现说明了保险发行人注册地的特殊性**（**离岸与属地监管辖区**）；**对做跨境保险监管或离岸保险市场研究的学生，这是一个具体的地理分布线索**。**④ 发行人条目带最近评级动作日期（实测 2026 年 9 月 4 日与 10 日）**——**说明该列表是当期维护的**；**「Assigned vs Surveillance」的区分与同轮 [[lianhe-ratings]] 的「初始评级 vs 定期跟踪」异曲同工，但 KBRA 把它做成筛选器而非类目页**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**该页的存在、标题、页面体量、面包屑、三重筛选的完整取值、以及若干发行人条目及其日期**，**但未打开任何一份评级报告、未打开 `publications` 子页内容、未核实该库的发行人总数或完整名单**，因此**不能转述任何发行人的具体等级、评级展望、评级理由或报告结论**——**实测看到的条目只含名称、日期、动作类型、子行业与地区，未含等级符号**；**② ⭐ 本次未核实该库是否可按「发行人名称」直接检索、是否需要登录**（**首页实测有 `Log In` 与 `Sign Up` 入口**）；**③ 本次未核实 KBRA 的监管资质（如是否为美国 SEC 认可的全国性统计评级机构）与成立年份**；**④ 「该页列出的是 KBRA 自己评级的发行人」属依据页面归属的合理判断**，**本词条不主张该名单覆盖市场上所有保险公司评级**；**⑤ 站点另有 Private Credit、Publications、Topics & Insights 等栏目，本次均未打开**；**⑥ 我最初猜测的 `/insurance` 路径实测为「Page Not Found」**——**真实路径为 `/sectors/insurance/issuers`**（**又一次「不要猜路径」**）；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** KBRA 提供精算工具、模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：`/sectors/insurance/issuers`（90.7KB）与首页均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取筛选取值与发行人条目；`/insurance` 实测为 Page Not Found；**未打开任何评级报告或 publications 子页**。
e.body_en:
**KBRA (Kroll Bond Rating Agency)** — its **insurance sector page**. This entry adds the **"public issuer database for insurance financial strength ratings"** form: **`rating agency` and `insurance financial strength` both measured zero**, **and this is the only one of this round’s four agencies whose page title carries "Insurance Financial Strength" directly**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Insurance Credit Ratings" page `/sectors/insurance/issuers` measures 90.7KB with the measured title "Insurance Credit Ratings | Insurance Financial Strength"**; **the measured breadcrumb is Home > Insurance > Insurance Issuers | Publications**. ⭐ **The page measurably offers three filters**: **Subsector** covering **Composite/Multi-Line**, **Financial Guaranty**, **Life/Health/Annuity**, **Non-Life/Property and Casualty** and **Reinsurance**; **Title Rating Action** covering **Assigned** and **Surveillance**; **Geography** covering **Europe (Belgium, France, Gibraltar, Guernsey, Luxembourg, United Kingdom)** and **North America (Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Puerto Rico, United States)**; plus **Filter by keyword**. ⭐ **The page measurably lists concrete issuer rows with action type and date**, such as **"California Earthquake Authority 10 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States"**, **"US Coastal Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States"** and **"US Coastal Property & Casualty Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance …"**. **Measured sector list**: **abs, cmbs, corporates, financial-institutions, funds, insurance, project-finance, public-finance, rmbs, sovereigns**, with **insurance carrying `issuers` and `publications` subpaths**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐ it adds the "public issuer database of insurance financial strength ratings"** — **the other three agencies this round ([[lianhe-ratings]], [[dagong]], [[r-i]]) centre on methodology plus rating results or default data**, **whereas KBRA discloses a filterable list of which insurers it rates**; **for insurer credit analysis or reinsurance counterparty assessment this is a directly searchable issuer list** (readable with the capital-measurement entries [[insurance-scr-data]] and [[sii-spread-risk-scr]] — **those compute how much capital a company must hold; this tells you how its financial strength has been scored**). **② ⭐ The five-way subsector split is itself a list of insurer types** — **composite/multi-line, financial guaranty, life/health/annuity, non-life P&C, reinsurance**; **note that "financial guaranty" and "reinsurance" are listed separately** — **two classes with the most distinctive credit risk structures in insurance** (**financial guaranty is credit enhancement in policy form; reinsurance is an insurer’s counterparty**), **and the agency placing them alongside life and P&C indicates a different risk lens**; **a directly citable classification for comparing risk by line**. **③ ⭐ The geography filter measurably covers six European and four North American jurisdictions including Bermuda, the Cayman Islands and Puerto Rico** — **their presence illustrates the special registration geographies of insurance issuers** (**offshore and territorial supervisory jurisdictions**); **a concrete geographic lead for students studying cross-border insurance regulation or offshore insurance markets**. **④ Issuer rows carry their latest rating-action date (measured 4 and 10 September 2026)** — **indicating a currently maintained list**; **the Assigned versus Surveillance distinction parallels [[lianhe-ratings]]’ initial versus periodic review, but KBRA implements it as a filter rather than category pages**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the page’s existence, title, size, breadcrumb, the complete values of the three filters, and several issuer rows with dates**, **but opened no rating report, opened no content on the `publications` subpath, and did not establish the database’s total issuer count or full list**, so **no issuer’s rating level, outlook, rationale or report conclusion can be restated** — **the measured rows carry only name, date, action type, subsector and geography, with no rating symbols**; **② ⭐ whether the database is searchable directly by issuer name, or requires login, was not verified** (**the homepage measurably carries `Log In` and `Sign Up`**); **③ KBRA’s regulatory status (for example whether it is a US SEC-recognised nationally recognised statistical rating organisation) and its founding year were not verified**; **④ that the page lists issuers rated by KBRA is a reasonable judgement from the page’s own placement**, **and this entry does not claim the list covers all insurer ratings in the market**; **⑤ the site’s other sections such as Private Credit, Publications and Topics & Insights were not opened**; **⑥ the path I first guessed, `/insurance`, measured "Page Not Found"** — **the real path is `/sectors/insurance/issuers`** (**another "do not guess paths"**); **⑦** this entry **does not claim KBRA provides actuarial tools, models or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: `/sectors/insurance/issuers` (90.7KB) and the homepage were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with filter values and issuer rows read verbatim; `/insurance` measured Page Not Found; **no rating report or publications subpage was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**KBRA（Kroll Bond Rating Agency，美國信用評級機構）** 的**保險部門頁面**——本條目補的是**「保險財務實力評級（Insurance Financial Strength）的公開發行人庫」這一形態**：**實測池內 `rating agency` / `insurance financial strength` 均為 0**，**而這是本輪四家機構中唯一在頁面標題直接寫出「保險財務實力」的一家**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「Insurance Credit Ratings」頁 `/sectors/insurance/issuers` 實測 90.7KB，標題實測為「Insurance Credit Ratings | Insurance Financial Strength」**；**麵包屑實測 Home > Insurance > Insurance Issuers | Publications**。⭐ **三重篩選實測**：**Subsector** 含 **Composite/Multi-Line／Financial Guaranty／Life/Health/Annuity／Non-Life/Property and Casualty／Reinsurance**；**Title Rating Action** 含 **Assigned／Surveillance**；**Geography** 含 **Europe（Belgium／France／Gibraltar／Guernsey／Luxembourg／United Kingdom）** 與 **North America（Bermuda／Cayman Islands／Puerto Rico／United States）**；另有 **Filter by keyword**。⭐ **頁面實測列出帶日期與動作類型的發行人條目**，例如 **「California Earthquake Authority 10 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States」**、**「US Coastal Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance …」**。**站點行業列表實測**：**abs／cmbs／corporates／financial-institutions／funds／insurance／project-finance／public-finance／rmbs／sovereigns**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐ 補上「保險財務實力評級的公開發行人庫」**——**本輪另外三家以「方法論 + 評級結果／違約數據」為主，而 KBRA 公開的是「我評了哪些保險公司」這一可篩選名單**；**對做保險公司信用分析或再保對手方評估的學生，這是可直接查找的發行人清單**（可與 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[sii-spread-risk-scr]] 並讀——**那些算「要留多少資本」，這條給「財務實力被打了什麼」**）。**② ⭐ 「子行業五分法」本身就是一份保險公司類型清單**；**注意單列了「金融擔保」與「再保險」**——**這兩類信用風險結構最特殊**，**評級機構把它們與壽險／產險並列，說明風險口徑不同**。**③ ⭐ 地區篩選涵蓋歐洲六地與北美四地（含百慕大、開曼、波多黎各）**——**說明保險發行人註冊地的特殊性**，**對做跨境監管或離岸保險市場研究是具體線索**。**④ 發行人條目帶最近評級動作日期（實測 2026-09-04 與 09-10）**——**說明列表是當期維護的**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**該頁的存在、標題、體量、麵包屑、三重篩選完整取值、以及若干發行人條目及其日期**，**但未打開任何評級報告、未打開 publications 子頁、未核實發行人總數**，故**不能轉述任何發行人的具體等級、展望、理由或報告結論**——**實測條目只含名稱、日期、動作類型、子行業與地區，未含等級符號**；**② ⭐ 是否可按發行人名稱直接檢索、是否需登入未核實**（**首頁實測有 `Log In` 與 `Sign Up`**）；**③ KBRA 的監管資質與成立年份未核實**；**④ 「列出的是 KBRA 自己評級的發行人」屬合理判斷**，**不主張該名單覆蓋市場上所有保險公司評級**；**⑤ 其他欄目本次均未打開**；**⑥ 我最初猜測的 `/insurance` 路徑實測為 Page Not Found**——**真實路徑為 `/sectors/insurance/issuers`**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** KBRA 提供精算工具、模型或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：兩個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測；`/insurance` 實測 Page Not Found；**未打開任何評級報告或 publications 子頁**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（⭐/sectors/insurance/issuers 90.7KB 标题实测「Insurance Credit Ratings | Insurance Financial Strength」，面包屑 Home > Insurance > Insurance Issuers | Publications；三重筛选实测 Subsector=Composite/Multi-Line / Financial Guaranty / Life/Health/Annuity / Non-Life/Property and Casualty / Reinsurance，Title Rating Action=Assigned / Surveillance，Geography=Europe（Belgium/France/Gibraltar/Guernsey/Luxembourg/UK）+ North America（Bermuda/Cayman Islands/Puerto Rico/US）；发行人条目实测「California Earthquake Authority 10 Sep 2026 Surveillance Non-Life/Property and Casualty United States」「US Coastal Insurance Company 4 Sep 2026 Surveillance …」；站点行业列表实测 abs/cmbs/corporates/financial-institutions/funds/insurance/project-finance/public-finance/rmbs/sovereigns）+ /insurance 实测 Page Not Found（我猜错路径，真实为 /sectors/insurance/issuers）+ ★池内 rating agency 与 insurance financial strength 均为 0；未打开任何评级报告或 publications 子页、未核实发行人总数与是否需登录、KBRA 监管资质与成立年份；实测条目未含评级符号，故不转述任何等级
